title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode1 Doing What I Can

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh wow...!
Ichika's become even better than before.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Her voice has so much more power and emotion behind it now, and it's so much fun to drum to it...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She did say that she worked on a song that we don't usually play for the Fan Festival, so could that be why...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Saki and Shiho look like they're having fun too.
 ...Alright, I'm not going to hold back!)
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whew...
Today's show was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought so too...!
It felt incredible to sing throughout all that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The crowd's been warming up to us more too. They seem a lot more into our music now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I noticed that too!
I couldn't help but dance a little while I played when I saw some people really getting into a groove♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when you were doing that shuffle?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki was dancing?
Hehe. I wish I could've seen that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You all seem much more comfortable on stage now too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, you didn't miss a note, and Ichika, you sound a lot more confident in your singing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You too, Honami. Before, you seemed hesitant, but you're drumming with more power now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All of you have been making some big strides.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho. That means a lot to us coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it really does...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If we keep playing shows like this, do you think we'll be able to go pro?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things won't be that easy, but we'll keep improving as we practice and play in more shows. For now, we should just maintain the pace we've established.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. We just need to keep putting everything into our practices and performances.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's pack up and head home.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I need to talk to the manager about our next show. Also, I should ask about my shift schedule, so you guys can go on ahead without me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for everything.
You know, for helping us actually perform in shows like this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask for any help if you ever think you need it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But this is really no big deal, so I can handle this on my own. If something does come up, I'll be sure to ask.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I should go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay, see you later...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Hona, where does this go again?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that goes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for today.
We really appreciate what you've been doing for us.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, Hinomori.
Leo/need's coming along pretty nicely, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. We'll be looking forward to next month's show.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Likewise. I can't wait to see where you girls go as you keep getting better and better as a band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise not to let you down.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I do have a question about our shows... Mainly regarding ticket sales...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
You don't have anything to worry about since the owner and I like your band so much.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Don't let that get in the way of you guys performing in any shows, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
Again, we really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we can't keep doing this forever, so starting with our next show, I'd like it if we could be treated like any other band when it comes to ticket sales.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
If you say so, Hinomori.
Shall we start discussing terms now?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes please.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Great work today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You too, Hona!
With more practice starting tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right.
We need to start working on our next song too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
I came up with a good melody, so I wanna have you guys hear it tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You did?
I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I'll be looking forward to it, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I won't let you down!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm sure we're all tired after today's show, so don't push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know! I know!
Shiho's gonna get mad at me again if I'm not careful♪
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye, Ichi, Hona!
See you tomorrow at school!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Bye. Get home safe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Bye bye.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Saki and Ichika are working so hard between writing songs for us and practicing for our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's been handling all the paperwork for those shows, while working with us on an individual basis during practices...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not sure if there's anything extra I can do for us, but I want to help. I'll try thinking of something...
